2. Match server_name in conf.d/routes/ svc-abc123.conf → MATCH
3. Get upstream from config: $upstream = http://cp-<depId>:3000
4. DNS lookup via Docker DNS (127.0.0.11) "cp-<depId>" → 172.18.0.5
